title: Slowakia Agricultural Land Idenfitication System
description: Official agricultural field boundaries for Slovakia, comprising 274,467 parcels from the Land Parcel Information System (LPIS) sourced via the National Open Data Catalog. Each record includes crop name, crop group, municipality, and field area. Data has been converted to fiboa GeoParquet format in EPSG:5514 projection.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Slovakia

Provides 274467 official field boundaries from Slovakia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from National Open Data Catalog (Národného katalógu otvorených dát).

- **Source Data Provider:** [National Open Data Catalog (Národného katalógu otvorených dát)](https://data.slovensko.sk/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** Open data
- **Projection:** EPSG:5514

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovakia/slovakia.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/slovakia/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovakia/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/slovakia/slovakia.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property     | **Data Type** | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|
| id           | string        |             |
| crop_name    | string        |             |
| crop_group   | string        |             |
| municipality | string        |             |
| area         | float         |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-14 from https://data.slovensko.sk/download?id=e39ad227-1899-4cff-b7c8-734f90aa0b59&blocksize=0 .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
